summary: Diff implements backend prompt persistence APIs and introduces a frontend backend-sync layer plus improved category selection/deduping and category bar click toggling. However, the diff evidence is truncated around the critical save/update paths, so it is not fully verifiable that newly-saved prompts/categories are always inserted into in-memory UI state immediately after Save, nor that category-based filtering + prompt opening works correctly in all view modes.

missing_requirements.requirement: After clicking Save on '+ Add Prompt', the newly created prompt appears in the currently active view/filter state as soon as Save completes; after refresh it is still present; on backend failure the dialog stays open and an error toast is shown.
missing_requirements.reason: Backend persistence and dialog behavior are partially evidenced (dialog closes only on success), but the diff summary is truncated for the save flow wiring (App -> onSave handler -> store update + backend call) and for the error toast on save failure. There is no clear evidence that the prompt is inserted into the in-memory prompt list immediately after a successful save under the current filter/view.
evidence: frontend/src/components/prompts/PromptEditorDialog.tsx (only closes dialog after awaited onSave; no toast here)
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptLibrarySync.ts (savePrompt implementation truncated before showing store update / toasts)
frontend/src/App.tsx (truncated; onSave wiring and view/filter update not shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: New categories created during '+ Add Prompt' are persisted and appear in CategoryFilterBar immediately after saving the prompt and remain after refresh; saving with existing categories does not create duplicates.
missing_requirements.reason: UI-side category dedupe/add is implemented, and backend category APIs exist, but the sync/persistence path for newly-created categories during prompt save is truncated. Also, immediate appearance in the CategoryFilterBar after saving the prompt depends on store updates after save, which are not fully visible.
evidence: frontend/src/components/categories/CategoryPicker.tsx (adds category to store immediately; does not show backend persistence)
frontend/src/features/backend/usePromptLibrarySync.ts (logic to find/persist new categories is present but truncated before completion)
frontend/src/features/backend/promptLibraryApi.ts (saveCategory exists, but no evidence it is invoked successfully in the save flow)

missing_requirements.requirement: Clicking a category filters prompts and selecting a prompt in list/grid/table opens the existing prompt preview behavior for that view; app stays on current view after Save.
missing_requirements.reason: CategoryFilterBar now toggles selection deterministically, but there is no direct diff evidence that category selection is correctly hooked into prompt filtering results and that prompt opening/preview works across list/grid/table in the filtered state. The relevant view components and selection handlers are not shown in the diff summary.
evidence: frontend/src/components/categories/CategoryFilterBar.tsx (only toggles selectedCategory via callback; no filtering/preview logic here)
frontend/src/App.tsx (truncated; filtering + view-mode prompt-open behavior not verifiable from provided excerpt)

hallucinated_features.description: Changed persistence strategy to no longer store prompts/categories in browser localStorage and to persist only UI preferences (viewMode).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses on fixing '+ Add Prompt' persistence to backend and UI state, not on changing/removing existing localStorage persistence behavior. This may be an implementation choice, but it is not explicitly requested.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (frontend/src/features/storage/localStorage.ts: 'no longer stores prompts or categories')
